# SRPE regression fixture

`srpe_sample.pdf` contains original pages **1, 2, 3, 11, 14, 247, 582,
590, 700, 285**, in that order, from `64048260626081RT.pdf`.

Source: [SRPE development 7705](https://www.srpe.gov.hk/opip/selected_dev?devId=7705),
THE PAVILIA FARM III. Source PDF SHA-256:
`06bb7fe8fda1f6eb66ecda650e63a3cdaf2a619dd9d4141daf891fdfd903216a`.

These unmodified source pages exercise normal tables, missing bottom borders,
multiple price/payment amendments, a contradictory source date, an explicit
PASP-not-proceeded statement, cross-year transactions, and a struck-out ASP
date with a replacement. The fixture contains **15 contract records**. Page
numbers emitted by tests refer to positions in this subset; printed page
numbers refer to the original PDF. This sample is not a representative market
dataset. Public source material retains its original ownership; the repository
MIT license applies to the project code.
